commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The attendance is 40896.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Sergi Canos (Valencia) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
88' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Luis Rioja is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Almeida (Valencia) replaces Javi Guerra.
84' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
84' The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
82' Javi Guerra (Valencia) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Thierry Correia will be replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Bryan Gil (Girona) coming on for Arnaut Danjuma.
79' Substitution. Donny van de Beek (Girona) in, Jhon Elmer Solis Romero out.
79' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Dani Gomez and he is replaced by German Valera (Valencia).
78' The game has come to an end for Bojan Miovski. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
76' Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Dani Gomez (Valencia) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
68' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
67' Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
65' Girona fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
65' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
62' Here is a change. Abel Ruiz is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Misehouy (Girona).
62' Substitution. Yangel Herrera (Girona) replaces Oriol Romeu.
60' Pepelu (Valencia) is the one who receives a yellow card.
58' 2 - 0 GOAL 2:0! Dani Gomez (Valencia) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
56' 1 - 0 Juanpe (Girona) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
53' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
50' Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
48' It looked like the long-range shot by Yaser Asprilla (Girona) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' What was Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
43' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' A wild pass somehow finds Diego Lopez (Valencia) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
31' Wasted opportunity! Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
28' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).
28' Pepelu (Valencia) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
26' Half-chance! Diego Lopez (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to snuff out the attack.
24' Juanpe (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
20' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Javi Guerra (Valencia) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
14' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) threads a pass through to Bojan Miovski, but Giorgi Mamardashvili breaks up the move.
13' Oriol Romeu (Girona) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
9' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
9' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
8' Pepelu (Valencia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Girona are awarded a free kick.
5' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
4' A spell of possession for Girona in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will officiate today.
